verdict.rationale: Productboard's AI 'automatically detects insights within feedback that can be linked to related feature ideas' (docs-16), and the MCP server lets an agent 'add new features' or 'start building off a product specification' (docs-10/12), which loosely resembles converting feedback into structured work items, but no evidence shows an explicit feature that ingests a plain-language feedback blurb and outputs a discrete list of proposed tasks. missing for 10: explicit feedback-to-task generation feature, examples of structured task/subtask output, and hands-on confirmation of this specific workflow.
